rules.title: Errors silenced
rules.description: -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue or empty catch on operations whose failure matters — the script reports success on failure.

rules.title: Plaintext credential
rules.description: Passwords, tokens, or connection strings as plaintext literals or ConvertFrom-SecureString without a key file story.

rules.title: Invoke-Expression on input
rules.description: Invoke-Expression (or iex) on strings containing external input — code injection.

rules.title: Write-Host in reusable code
rules.description: Write-Host inside functions/scripts whose output may be piped or captured — breaks the pipeline. Use Write-Output/Write-Verbose.
